sources.name: OurAirports airports.csv and runways.csv
sources.use: airport identity, location, open runway count

sources.name: FAA commercial service enplanements CY2024 and CY2025
sources.use: enplanements CY23 to CY25, hub class, rank, airport universe

sources.name: BTS T-100 Segment (US Carriers Only), domestic and international
BTS On-Time Performance, 12 monthly files
sources.use: departure delay rate, cancellation rate, taxi-out time

rules: T-100: rows with zero departures performed and rows with origin equal to destination are removed
T-100: a row with seats above 0 is a passenger row. Other rows are cargo rows
Distance buckets are 500 miles wide, weighted by departures performed
On-Time: delay rate = departures delayed 15 minutes or more / flights that did not cancel
Codes are matched to OurAirports by IATA code, then FAA code, then aliases.csv
limits: On-Time covers large reporting carriers only
Some airports have no On-Time data
